title: Prostate fluid test
what: The doctor massages the prostate with a finger through the rectum. The drop of fluid that comes out is sent to the lab.
why: For suspected prostate inflammation, pain in the area between the legs, or problems peeing.
duration: the procedure usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; results usually come in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: If you have a fever or severe pain right now
If you have hemorrhoids or anal fissures
If you recently had other urology tests

prepare.title: Abstinence
prepare.text: You are usually asked to avoid sex and ejaculation for 2 to 3 days. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol, sauna, or steam bath. A normal shower in the morning.

prepare.title: Bowels
prepare.text: Try to go to the toilet before the procedure. Sometimes you are asked to do an enema. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Antibiotics
prepare.text: If you are taking antibiotics, tell your doctor. They will decide when best to test.

steps: You kneel on your knees and elbows, or lie on your side
The doctor inserts a gloved, lubricated finger into the rectum
The prostate is massaged for a few seconds
A drop of fluid is collected on a slide or in a tube
Sometimes you are asked to give a urine sample afterward
feel: Uncomfortable pressure and an urge to pee
Sometimes mild pain. Tell the doctor
after: You can return to normal activities right away
Discuss the result with your doctor
red_flags: A fever over 38°C (100.4°F) after the procedure
Severe pain between the legs, or you cannot pee

faq.a: Usually it is uncomfortable, but not painful. It takes less than a minute.

faq.q: What if no fluid comes out?
faq.a: That happens. Sometimes you give a urine sample right after the massage, or it is repeated.

reminders.text: Prostate fluid test in 2 days. You are usually asked to avoid sex, alcohol, and saunas for 2 to 3 days before.
